answers.core: Since you can set the order of items within PopupMenu's `items` property in the editor, it feels very unintuitive that you cannot also set them within a script
answers.workaround: You'd have to ignore the PopupMenu's `items` property in the editor, and write your own script to add all the items. This is a lot of extra effort for just changing the position of a submenu item

title: Add a way to change the order of `PopupMenu` items
